method: Ordered comparison: finesse.prompt.rstrip().endswith("Question: " + official.qa.question); finesse.answer == str(official.qa.exe_ans). This checks question and reference identity, not context bytes or normalized answer/exe_ans disagreement.
byte_note: Initial local text-mode save converted LF to CRLF; raw pinned bytes were re-downloaded and all parsed records proved identical. The hashes here are raw HTTP bytes.
scope: Data identity only; shared model-error percentages are author-reported and were not recomputed. No answer/exe_ans inconsistency rate is inferred from string equality.
